summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Immatics N.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 18, 2026. The filing summarizes shareholder approvals of routine agenda items including adoption of statutory annual accounts, discharge of board members, reappointment of directors, extension of share buyback authorization, approval of a 2026 stock option and incentive plan, and appointment of auditors. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is described. The filing is a standard corporate governance update and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
